Ahabw\'ebiragiro bya Play Store, %1$s terikubaasa kushaba kuhikwaho eby\'okutereka byona aha. Okuhika aha fayiro zoona, yeshengyereze oihemu %1$s kuruga Github. Ekindi, noobaasa kwikiriza kuhikwaho ebishushani, obutambi, hamwe na fayiro z\'amahurire omu ntebekanisa.
